spans.s: Saubala^2, pl. (ºāḥ) (“the sons of Subala”). § 585 (Bhīshma-vadhap.): VI, 90, 4010 (i.e. Gaja, etc.; cf. v. 3997), 4012. Cf. Subalalātmaja, pl.
Saubala^3, adj. (“belonging to Saubala [i.e. Śakuni]”). § 580 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 58, 2485 (ºīṃ senāṃ).
Saubalaka, pl. (ºāḥ), the followers of Śakuni. § 580 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 58^4, 2469 (śūrāḥ, attacked Sātyaki; cf. Gāndhārāḥ, v. 2468).
Saubalya, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 347 (only C., B. has Sauśalyāḥ).
